purpose: Small natural-image implementation sanity check; not reproduction of published Caltech101 accuracy
class_selection: numpy default_rng(seed), choose 20 without replacement from sorted categories excluding BACKGROUND_Google and Faces; require at least 28 images; sort selected categories
image_selection: continue same RNG; permute sorted filenames per class, first 8 support, next 4 validation, next 16 test
backbone: Same frozen OpenAI CLIP RN50 and verified checkpoint as SPV run
preprocess: Official CLIP RGB/resize/center crop/normalize; no SPV maximum brightness conversion; no stochastic augmentation
templates: a black and white photo of a {}.
a low contrast photo of a {}.
a high contrast photo of a {}.
class_names: Replace underscores with spaces; remove trailing numbered suffix; Faces_easy -> face, Leopards -> leopard, Motorbikes -> motorbike
prototype: Reuse actual SPV evaluate.py build function with c=20; independent reconstruction for verification
alpha_selection: Reuse SPV choose function and its frozen grid; validation only; do not add validation images to support
test_rule: Save selected alpha before test scoring, no protocol tuning after test results
engineering_screen: PA_FULL, PA_VISUAL and PLAIN test accuracy >=50 percent is a coarse predeclared functionality screen, not a research significance claim or a required PA improvement; if failed investigate rather than tune test
limitations: 20 categories, one split, 8-shot, custom seven template ensemble, deterministic views; not original paper benchmark reproduction; duplicate image hashes checked across splits
